rundown: Pacers beat Wizards 114-101 at Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, IN in front of 16,679. Pacers led 55-50 at the half and never looked back. The 4th quarter decided it: Pacers won it 37-24. Their win chance dropped as low as 27% along the way.
Leading the way — Wizards: Kyshawn George 25 pts; Trae Young 4 ast; Anthony Davis 13 reb. Pacers: Pascal Siakam 28 pts; Andrew Nembhard 10 ast; Ivica Zubac 12 reb.
Where Pacers won it: they shot 47% to 41%, had 29 assists to 12 and turned it over 11 times to 14.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Pacers closed as 3.5-point favorites and covered by 9.5; the total closed at 227.5 and they combined for 215, under by 12.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 11, 6:56 PM ET. It had Wizards 27% and Pacers 73%, projecting Wizards 109.2 – Pacers 116.4 (225.6 total, Pacers by 7.2).

Final: Wizards 101 – Pacers 114. Right winner: it had Pacers at 73%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Wizards came in with a 2% below average attack and a 2% leakier than average defense (4-7, 108.1 scored and 113.4 allowed a game over 11 games), worth about 67 and 68 games of evidence. Projected to score 109.2, they scored 101 (−8.2 points, 7% under); projected to allow 116.4, they allowed 114 (−2.4 points, 2% under).

Pacers came in with a league-average attack and a 2% leakier than average defense (3-8, 111.4 scored and 115.2 allowed a game over 11 games), worth about 62 and 62 games of evidence. Projected to score 116.4, they scored 114 (−2.4 points, 2% under); projected to allow 109.2, they allowed 101 (−8.2 points, 7% under).

The bigger miss was Wizards' scoring (-8.2 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 215 against 225.6 projected (-10.6), about the 28th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Pacers by 13 against Pacers by 7.2 projected, about the 69th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
IND ML (-154) at -154: the algo gave it 61% vs 58% fair (+2.4 pts) — won (+0.6u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 58%). WSH ML (+130) at +130: the algo gave it 39% vs 42% fair (-2.4 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 42%). IND -3.5 (-104) at -104: the algo gave it 51% vs 49% fair (+2 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. WSH +3.5 (-116) at -116: the algo gave it 49% vs 51% fair (-2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 228.5 (-106) at -106: the algo gave it 48% vs 49% fair (-0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the closing 227.5 by 1. UNDER 228.5 (-114) at -114: the algo gave it 52% vs 51% fair (+0.8 pts) — won (+0.9u); beat the closing 227.5 by 1.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: total 228.5 → 227.5. The total moved toward the algo's number.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 55% of bets on Wizards, 63% of the money — Pacers covered; total: 69% of bets on the over, 74% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 36% of bets on Wizards, 43% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Wizards, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.944 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +6.1 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 54 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.990 and gives home teams +0.3 points. Team corrections so far: Wizards attack ×0.988, defense ×1.015 (5 games); Pacers attack ×1.000, defense ×0.989 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
